content:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD#RDW-7921 — geo-synthetic probe cluster 'eu3-geo-probe' failing threshold (5/5 failures in 2m). Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/RDW-7921 :rotating_light:

pd-bot: Alert details: check=geo-probe-eu3, probe_id=geo-eu3-172, symptom=HTTP 502, avg_latency=1200ms, triggered_by=consecutive_failures

oncall_maria: Acked on PD and here. I'm taking initial triage. Will check if this is probe-only or correlates with customer traffic.

ben_sre: thanks. Looking at synth pipeline — we see elevated 502s from the prober to backend pool eu3-proxy-1/2. No recent deploys in the last hour.

jordan_infra: I can tail the edge proxies. Hitting: ssh infra-proxy-eu3-01 and checking nginx/error.log

alice_prodeng: fwiw, no customer-reported errors in GA telemetry yet. App-level error rate for inbound requests to model endpoints is within normal variance. Could be probe specific.

oncall_maria: ok running the prober re-run now: 
```bash
# re-run single probe job
kubectl -n synth exec -it job/geo-probe-172 -- /usr/local/bin/probe --target=https://eu3.redwood.example/healthcheck
```

ben_sre: output shows 502 and a short stack: 
```
503 upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response header from upstream, client: 10.10.10.5, server: eu3-proxy
```

jordan_infra: pulling proxy metrics: CPU 68%, conn_saturated 12% (normal), upstream pool eu3-backend shows a few 502 spikes at 15:04:12 and 15:05:34. Checking load balancer health checks.

oncall_maria: I'm going to put the synthetic fanout into reduced mode to stop noise while we debug. Runbook: synth-fanout->reduce: 
```bash
# reduce probe concurrency from 20 -> 4
kubectl -n synth patch configmap probes --patch '{"data":{"concurrency":"4"}}'
```

pd-bot: PD updated: incident rerouted to SRE escalation policy. Current urgency: high (synthetic+potential downstream).

alice_prodeng: If it's proxy upstream closing, could be transient backend GC or networking. Any 5xxs in backend logs around 15:05?

ben_sre: grep in backend logs shows repeated "worker OOM-kill" messages on eu3-worker-4 at 15:04:58 then restarted by kubelet. That matches time window.

jordan_infra: eu3-worker-4 shows oom_killer in dmesg. Node memory pressure triggered. Node had noisy batch job. I'm isolating the node and cordoning. Command: 
```bash
kubectl cordon eu3-worker-4 && kubectl drain eu3-worker-4 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```

oncall_maria: Nice catch. I'll mark the PD incident notes: root cause likely node OOM causing upstream 502s for probes. Customer-facing impact: none observed in prod telemetry, only synth probes and a small transient bump in proxy 5xx.

ben_sre: After cordon/drain, probe retry shows success for new runs. Re-enable probe concurrency gradually.

oncall_maria: Mitigation completed: eu3-worker-4 drained and cordoned, pod replicas redistributed. Probe concurrency lowered and now incrementally restored. PD status: acknowledged -> investigating -> resolved (monitoring). Logged PD#RDW-7921 note: "Node OOM caused synthetic probe failures; cordoned node, redistributed pods, increased memory limit on batch job; monitoring for recurrence."

alice_prodeng: Follow-up action: increase resource limits for the batch job on eu3 by 30% and add OOM alert on node memory_pressure metric. Filing jira: RDW-INC-2043

jordan_infra: creating kube patch to bump request/limit and add liveness threshold. Patch preview: 
```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: geo-batch
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: batch-runner
        resources:
          requests:
            memory: "1Gi"
          limits:
            memory: "2Gi"
```

ben_sre: Can we also add a synthetic-only suppression rule for this probe group so PD noise doesn't keep paging on expected remediation windows? I'll open a PR to the prober config.

oncall_maria: yes please. Also handoff notes for next oncall: summary below.

oncall_maria: HANDOFF: PD#RDW-7921 — synth probe eu3 fired due to node OOMs causing upstream 502s to probes. Actions taken: cordoned/drained eu3-worker-4, redistributed pods, lowered probe concurrency temporarily, increased memory limits planned, created jira RDW-INC-2043. No customer-facing errors detected. Monitor eu3 proxy 5xx and node memory for 2 hours.

alice_prodeng: thx. I'm adding a short eval to Redwood Optimize to correlate synth failures with backend OOMs so triggers are smarter.

pd-bot: PD incident RDW-7921 resolved by oncall_maria at 2026-02-18T15:20:00Z

ben_sre: closing thread here. please ping if the synthetic noise resumes or if any customers surface errors. :thumbsup:
